mapper.select: SELECT "STOCK_COUNT", "STOCK_PURCHASE" FROM "ASSETS" WHERE "USERNAME" = #{username} AND LPAD("ASSET_NO", 6, '0') = LPAD(#{stockCode}, 6, '0')

SELECT A."ASSET_NO", A."STOCK_COUNT", A."STOCK_PURCHASE", A."USERNAME", S."STOCK_NO", S."STOCK_CODE", S."STOCK_NAME" FROM "ASSETS" A JOIN "STOCK" S ON A."ASSET_NO" = S."STOCK_CODE" WHERE A."USERNAME" = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "ORDER" ( "ORDER_TYPE", "ORDER_PRICE", "ORDER_COUNT", "ORDER_DATE", "STOCK_NO", "STOCK_CODE", "USERNAME", "STATUS" ) VALUES ( #{orderType}, #{orderPrice}, #{orderCount}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, (SELECT "STOCK_NO" FROM "STOCK" WHERE "STOCK_CODE" = #{stockCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), #{stockCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{username}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT O."ORDER_ID", O."ORDER_TYPE", O."ORDER_PRICE", O."ORDER_COUNT", O."ORDER_DATE", O."STOCK_NO", O."STOCK_CODE", O."USERNAME", TRIM(O."STATUS") AS "STATUS", S."STOCK_NAME" FROM "ORDER" O JOIN "STOCK" S ON O."STOCK_NO" = S."STOCK_NO" WHERE O."USERNAME" = #{username} ORDER BY O."ORDER_DATE" DESC

SELECT O."ORDER_ID", O."ORDER_TYPE", O."ORDER_PRICE", O."ORDER_COUNT", O."ORDER_DATE", O."STOCK_NO", O."STOCK_CODE", O."USERNAME", TRIM(O."STATUS") AS "STATUS", S."STOCK_NAME" FROM "ORDER" O JOIN "STOCK" S ON O."STOCK_NO" = S."STOCK_NO" WHERE O."USERNAME" = #{username} AND TRIM(O."STATUS") = 'PENDING' ORDER BY O."ORDER_DATE" DESC

SELECT "ORDER_ID" AS "orderId", "ORDER_TYPE" AS "orderType", "ORDER_PRICE" AS "orderPrice", "ORDER_COUNT" AS "orderCount", "STOCK_CODE" AS "stockCode", "USERNAME" AS "username", TRIM("STATUS") AS "status" FROM "ORDER" WHERE TRIM("STATUS") = 'PENDING' ORDER BY "ORDER_DATE" ASC

SELECT "ORDER_ID" AS "orderId", "ORDER_TYPE" AS "orderType", "ORDER_PRICE" AS "orderPrice", "ORDER_COUNT" AS "orderCount", "STOCK_CODE" AS "stockCode", "USERNAME" AS "username", "STATUS" AS "status" FROM "ORDER" WHERE "ORDER_ID" = #{orderId}
